descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S24 「截图包：10 个状态每个一张截图，附在 UAT 上」 Screenshot pack: one screenshot of each of the 10 states, attached to the UAT

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 A screenshot of each of the 10 states, as built, is attached to the UAT so testers know what 'correct' looks like.（TFA-94745 AC 8；UAT EFS intro）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android.（UAT EFS Expected Result；UAT 3.3；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given The screenshots saved by S01, S02, S06 to S11, S14, S16, S17 and S27 (web, both contexts) and S18 (iOS, Android)

When Pick one per state, label each with the state number, attach them under the EFS table in the UAT doc; add per-context and per-platform shots where they exist

Then All 10 states have a screenshot; Daniela confirms they show what 'correct' looks like

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Document check against TFA-94745 AC 8: a missing state is a Fail. Per-context and per-platform shots are a note, not a Fail, until Q3 says they are required. The attach step is done by Quinn or Daniela, never by the agent; it also settles the 'existing style' reference (Q3)

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 DOC · 文档核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：DOC · 文档核对；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：code-review。
